# Files that still carry Turkish, with the number of lines each carries.
#
# The tree is written in English. The files below are not untranslated prose:
# each one carries Turkish because Turkish is what the line is about, a
# roundtrip test feeding non-ASCII through the JSONL encoder, the stopword list
# the embedder strips, and the character set the language detector measures.
# They are recorded so the gate ratchets instead of failing on every commit.
#
# The numbers only go DOWN. Translating lines lowers a count; a file that
# reaches zero has its line deleted. The gate fails if a count goes up, if a
# file not listed here gains Turkish, and also if a count is higher than what
# is actually in the file, so progress cannot go unrecorded.
#
# Turkish is allowed in exactly two places, neither of which is listed here:
# README.tr.md, and the word "Türkçe" as the label on the link to it.
#
# Format: <path>\t<remaining Turkish lines>
# Recorded: 2026-08-25. 3 files, 7 lines. The vocabulary the gate scans with
# was widened from 60 words to 156 on this date; the 132 lines it had been
# walking past were translated in the same change.
crates/agent/crates/agent-data/src/jsonl.rs	2
crates/agent/crates/agent-knowledge/src/embed.rs	1
crates/agent/crates/agent-tune/src/schema.rs	4
